_meta.description: Master registry of all reusable code assets across clients. Three tiers: injectable snippets, commons library sub-flows, and Anypoint Exchange fragments.

tiers.1: Inline XML/DWL snippets injected by scaffold/generate.js at generation time
tiers.2: Sub-flows and DWL functions in commons/ (mule-plugin, published to Exchange)
tiers.3: Canonical API schemas and RAML/OAS fragments published to Anypoint Exchange

_meta.usageRule: When adding a new client capability: check this registry first. If present, reference it. If absent, add it here before adding to the client project — this registry is the only path for capabilities.

idempotency-check.description: Object Store deduplication check; ACKs and skips duplicate MQ/Kafka messages

wire-tap.description: Async audit copy of every message into a separate audit queue; zero impact on primary flow latency

invalid-message-channel-route.description: Routes structurally invalid messages to IMC queue BEFORE downstream calls; never retried

claim-check-store.description: Write payload to S3; replace with claim check token for payloads > 1MB

claim-check-retrieve.description: Retrieve full payload from S3 using claim check token; delete after processing

correlation-id-propagate.description: Set X-Correlation-ID header on every outbound HTTP call

common-route-to-dlq.description: Publishes failed message to DLQ with full error envelope; logs at ERROR level

common-build-error-response.description: Builds standard HTTP error JSON envelope; sets vars.httpStatus=500; never exposes stack trace

common-retry-with-backoff.description: Exponential backoff retry loop using Object Store for state; publishes to retry queue after each failure; routes to DLQ after maxRetries
common-retry-with-backoff.injectOn: all async consumer flows where errorHandling.strategy=retry-then-dlq

common-dispatch-notification.description: Fire-and-forget notification dispatch: Slack webhook + SMTP email. Reads enabled channels from properties. Failure never breaks primary flow.

common-batch-on-complete.description: Batch job on-complete handler: logs success/failure counts, publishes summary to notification channel, stores watermark on success

common-generate-correlation-id.description: Generates UUID v4 correlationId; sets as Mule correlationId (not a variable); propagates X-Correlation-ID on all outbound calls
common-generate-correlation-id.injectOn: all Experience API entry flows (HTTP listener only)

error-envelope.description: Builds standard error envelope: {correlationId, errorCode, message, timestamp, failingComponent}. Never exposes stack trace.

pii-mask.description: Field-level PII masking: email → first 3 chars + ***@***.com, phone → ***-***-NNNN, SSN → ***-**-NNNN, card → ****-****-****-NNNN

canonical-date.description: Normalises any date string (ISO 8601, US M/d/yyyy, epoch ms, yyyyMMdd) to canonical ISO date or epoch ms. Handles null safely.
usedIn: all DataWeave transforms involving date fields

build-audit-record.description: Builds a tamper-evident audit log record: {auditId, correlationId, timestamp, environment, actor, action, resource, result, maskedPayload}

canonical-order.description: Canonical order entity schema: orderId, customerId, lines[], status, totals, fulfillment, timestamps

canonical-customer.description: Canonical customer entity schema: customerId, name, addresses[], contacts[], segment, status

canonical-invoice.description: Canonical invoice entity schema: invoiceId, orderId, customerId, lines[], totals, paymentStatus, dueDate
